fact: Sonatel's XOF 75 billion securitization bonds (January 2024) were placed on the local market, with 57 percent of non-anchor subscriptions of XOF 26.5 billion from investors in Senegal including banks, pension funds and insurers; proceeds fund 4G and fibre.
title: IFC Invests in Sonatel's First Securitization to Expand Connectivity in Senegal
